opening: I am applying for the Applied AI Engineer role because Dwelly is building agentic infrastructure around real operational workflows rather than treating AI as a standalone feature. That matches the practical automation and product work I have delivered across European startups.
core: Over the past three years I have turned business requirements into production features across several European technology projects.
At UltraStrategy I built an AI-based CV parsing workflow using n8n and Eden AI, and at Clubee I worked on API integration and QA.
At FlowSpace I built AI support agents, GTM automations and data-parsing tools while helping grow the platform from 2,000 to more than 4,500 users.
I use Claude Code alongside TypeScript, Next.js, Laravel and Supabase, and verify generated changes before shipping them.
I am based in Venice, hold an EU long-term residence permit and am available immediately.
role_specific: My strongest fit is applied AI inside real workflows. I have connected model outputs to product and operational actions and contributed to a live migration from Bubble to Next.js and Laravel. These projects taught me to validate probabilistic outputs, design explicit failure paths, and decide when deterministic software or human review is safer.
closing: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this production-focused approach to agents, evaluation and workflow automation could contribute to Dwelly.
